skill.name: framework-migration-code-migrate
skill.description: Helps plan and guide migrations between frameworks, languages, versions, APIs, data stores, and platforms with testing and rollback guidance.
skill.summary: Plan safer code migrations with analysis, phased execution, testing, and rollback guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives caused by Markdown inline code or JavaScript template literals in example migration generators. I confirmed a user controlled output file write in the sample CLI and a third-party CDN script in the generated dashboard as practical reuse risks. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Generated CLI writes analysis output to a user supplied path.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain output to the project workspace, check for existing files, and require explicit overwrite confirmation.

remediation.issue: Generated dashboard loads Chart.js from a hardcoded public CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an exact version with integrity metadata or bundle a vetted local dependency.

remediation.issue: Executable migration examples need stronger safety framing.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to run dry-run mode first, create backups, and review generated changes before execution.

content.value_statement: Framework migrations are risky because behavior, dependencies, and tests can drift. This skill provides structured plans, examples, checks, and rollback guidance for controlled migrations.
actual_capabilities: Assesses source code characteristics, complexity, dependencies, and migration risks.
Builds phased migration plans with milestones, success criteria, and rollback steps.
Provides examples for framework, language, API, data, and cloud migrations.
Outlines testing strategies for functionality, performance, data integrity, APIs, and user flows.
Shows automation patterns for migration CLI tools and progress dashboards.
limitations: Does not validate generated scripts against a real production environment.
Requires user review before running migration automation or file writes.
Examples may need adaptation for each framework version and architecture.
Does not replace security, compliance, or data migration review.

use_cases.title: Plan a Legacy Upgrade
use_cases.description: Assess an older application, identify high-risk areas, and create a phased upgrade path with validation gates.

use_cases.title: Design Migration Tests
use_cases.description: Define comparison tests for behavior, performance, data integrity, APIs, and user flows before release.

use_cases.title: Prepare Rollback Guidance
use_cases.description: Create rollback procedures, monitoring checks, and stakeholder steps for a controlled production migration.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Migration Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment for a new migration request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration assessment for [source stack] to [target stack]. Identify scope, risks, dependencies, and required inputs before planning.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Phased Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a real application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a phased migration plan for [application]. Include timeline, milestones, validation checks, rollback steps, and owner responsibilities.

prompt_templates.title: Design Safe Automation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced automation planning before writing scripts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design migration automation for [repository]. Propose safe dry-run behavior, backups, test gates, logs, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Strategies
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced decision support for complex migrations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare two migration strategies for [system]. Evaluate risk, sequencing, data impact, deployment model, test coverage, and rollback constraints.

output_examples.input: Migrate a React class component application to Vue.
output: Assessment of component patterns, state usage, lifecycle methods, and routing dependencies.
Phased migration plan with component batches, test coverage, and rollback checkpoints.
Examples for translating lifecycle logic and template structure.

output_examples.input: Upgrade a Python 2 service to Python 3.
output: Inventory of syntax, dependency, encoding, iterator, and exception handling changes.
Migration sequence that separates automated transforms from manual review.
Validation plan for unit tests, integration tests, and production parity checks.

output_examples.input: Move a REST API toward GraphQL.
output: Endpoint analysis mapped to queries, mutations, types, and resolver responsibilities.
Testing checklist for payload shape, authorization behavior, and client compatibility.
Rollback guidance for keeping REST endpoints available during transition.

best_practices: Start with an inventory of dependencies, runtime assumptions, data flows, and release constraints.
Use phased migration with dry runs, automated tests, observability, and rollback gates.
Review generated scripts before execution and keep backups for changed files and data.
anti_patterns: Running generated migration tools directly against production systems.
Migrating framework syntax without testing behavior, data integrity, and performance.
Skipping rollback planning until after a failed deployment.

faq.question: What migration types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers framework, language, API, data, cloud, and version migrations through planning and example patterns.

faq.question: Can it run the migration automatically?
faq.answer: It can design automation patterns, but users should review scripts and run dry runs before execution.

faq.question: Does it replace framework-specific documentation?
faq.answer: No. Use official framework documentation to verify version-specific APIs, deprecations, and upgrade steps.

faq.question: How should teams reduce migration risk?
faq.answer: Use small phases, comparison tests, monitoring, backups, and rollback procedures before production rollout.

faq.question: Is this useful for data migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes planning patterns for data mapping, integrity checks, validation, and rollback controls.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
